title: Summary: Objects and the Pipeline
objective: Make three files, then print how many there are, and the names that sort first and last.
hint: Make the files, then $files = Get-ChildItem with -Path and -File. Three Write-Output lines: Files: with $($files.Count), then First: and Last:, each with a pipeline inside $(...) that sorts $files by Name and selects -First 1 or -Last 1, then .Name.
